app.title: VUW World Model
app.description: Unofficial student-made 3D map of the buildings of the Kelburn Campus of Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington. Not affiliated with Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington.
app.ogDescription: See the buildings of VUW's Kelburn Campus on a 3D model of Kelburn, Wellington, drawn from OpenStreetMap. Unofficial; not affiliated with Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington.
app.noscript: VUW World Model is an unofficial 3D map of the buildings of the Kelburn Campus of Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington. It needs JavaScript and WebGL to run. It is not affiliated with Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington.
app.loadError: The map data could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
app.noWebgl: This browser could not start WebGL, so the 3D map is not shown. Search for buildings still works.
app.sceneLabel: 3D map of VUW's Kelburn Campus. Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag or two fingers to move.

about.unofficial: VUW World Model is made by a student for students. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or maintained by Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington, and it uses no VUW logo. Its colours are the project's own, the same for every school, and none is taken from VUW. It shows the buildings of VUW's Kelburn Campus only, from OpenStreetMap. For anything that matters, check VUW's own campus maps and your own timetable.

limits.timetable: No class times. VUW publishes its Academic Timetable as spreadsheets that give a room for every class, but they are in a part of its site that its robots.txt asks automated visitors to leave alone, so the site does not take them. Its course pages give lecture times without rooms. Nothing here is made up to fill the gap.
limits.timetableLoaded: Class times come from a snapshot of VUW's Academic Timetable taken on {date}. Rooms and times change during the trimester; your own timetable is the authority.
limits.scheduled: A timetabled class is not the same as an occupied room. Classes are cancelled, moved and held online, and rooms are used for things that are not on the timetable.
limits.heights: Each of VUW's buildings is one block on its OpenStreetMap outline, with no floors. Its height comes from OpenStreetMap: its height tag where it has one; else its number of levels, {height} m each; else 6.5 m, or 10 m for a building over 900 m², the defaults of the surrounding buildings. The building card says which. None of these heights is surveyed: most of VUW's buildings have a number of levels in OpenStreetMap and stand that many storeys high, and the rest stand at a default. The windows and the rim round each roof are drawn by rule and say nothing about the real walls and roofs. The ground's heights come from Land Information New Zealand's 8 m elevation model of 2012, which is drawn from contours: it is smooth bare ground, with sharp peaks a few metres low. A building stands on the ground under its middle; on a slope its uphill side goes into the hill and a footing fills the gap below the other side.
limits.rooms: No floors and no rooms. VUW publishes no floor or room outlines: its floor plans are pictures. Its list of teaching rooms, with codes and capacities, is public, and its copyright page allows non-commercial reproduction only accurately and without modifications; the site does not show the list until the project's maintainer decides how it may be used. So each building is one block, and nothing inside it is drawn.
limits.campuses: Only the Kelburn Campus is modelled. Pipitea and Te Aro each need an OpenStreetMap snapshot of their own, which has not been taken, and the Auckland premises, the Miramar Creative Centre and VUW's other sites are not modelled. A building on the Kelburn Campus is drawn as VUW's only where OpenStreetMap tags it as a university building, or names VUW as its operator, and gives it a name; any other stands among the surrounding buildings, with no name.
limits.context: Surrounding buildings, streets and trees come from OpenStreetMap. Where it maps a building in parts or gives a roof a shape, those are drawn, the roof in a simplified form. Where a height is not mapped, a default is used. In the walker views every building, VUW's and the rest, is drawn with storeys from its height, windows, and walls of plaster, brick, concrete, stone, glass or weatherboard chosen by rule from where it stands; none of it says what a real building looks like, and there are no doors, since none are mapped. The ground there is drawn by rule as well, on the streets, paths, railways, parks and ponds OpenStreetMap maps: asphalt with white lines, kerbs, paving slabs, steps, sleepers and rails, lawns and water, and grass and bare earth elsewhere. Its widths, lines and kerbs say nothing about the real ones, and there are no crossings, arrows or signs, since none are mapped. A tree standing alone is where OpenStreetMap maps it; its size and shape are drawn by rule, and in the walker views so are its leaves, its bark and the way it sways in a light breeze, the same every day; none of it says what kind of tree it is. Trees OpenStreetMap tags as deciduous turn in April and May, stand bare from June to August and come into leaf in September and October; the rest are drawn evergreen. Trees inside woodland areas are scattered for decoration.
limits.walker: The walker is a made-up figure, not a person: it stands for nobody, and nothing about where it goes leaves your browser. Its walks are planned round the buildings on the map and along OpenStreetMap's paths and streets, off motorways except over footbridges. Doors and entrances are not mapped, so a walk to a building ends beside its nearest wall, and it passes gates, fences and kerbs the map does not have. Its body is the "Animated Human" model by Quaternius, given to the public domain (CC0); its stance, trainers, hair, mouth, backpack and umbrella are drawn here by rule, in the project's own colours, none taken from VUW. Where a building or a tree hides it, its shape shows through. An agent can steer it on your own computer through the scripts in the source code.
limits.subjects: No course list. VUW publishes its courses in a printable course catalogue, and its copyright page allows non-commercial reproduction only accurately and without modifications. The site does not take the catalogue until the project's maintainer decides how it may be used.
limits.calendar: No trimester dates. VUW publishes its key dates in a part of its site that its robots.txt asks automated visitors to leave alone, so the site does not take them, and the time panel moves the sun and the light only.
limits.daylight: The sun stands where it does over VUW's Kelburn Campus at the date and time shown, from NOAA's published solar-position equations; below 10° above the horizon it is drawn at 10°, so that shadows stay on the map. Night falls as the sun goes from 6° above the horizon to 8° below. In Now mode the cloud, rain and fog follow Open-Meteo's current weather for VUW's Kelburn Campus, and the falling rain is drawn by rule; Preview shows a clear sky, because past and future weather are not known here.

about.privacy: The site has no accounts and sets no cookies. It holds no names of people. Only the copy at campusworldmodel.com is counted: there Cloudflare, which serves the site, counts page views and visits with its Web Analytics. It stores nothing in your browser and does not record which building you look at; a content blocker may stop it. If the weather line is shown, your browser asks Open-Meteo for the current weather at VUW's Kelburn Campus; nothing about you is sent beyond that request. A walk with the walker stays in your browser: where it goes, what it says and what it wears are not sent anywhere.

room.noTimetableWhy: VUW's class times are not taken by this site, so it cannot say what is scheduled here. See About for details.

search.hint: Type a building's name, for example Hunter Building or Rankine Brown. Rooms and courses are not shown: see About.
search.noResultsHint: VUW's buildings are found by the names OpenStreetMap gives them; a few are named by their street and number, such as KP10 or FT81. Building names work with or without macrons.

travel.go: Travel to {name}. This leaves VUW World Model.
